sections.content: “The Self” is a multifaceted part of our human experience.
There is our immediate overall sense of self - the feeling you have about yourself right now that makes up who you are.
Beyond the immediate sense of self we have various layers which are both experienced as their own individual selves and contribute to our overall sense of self.
The term “Self” is one that I resonate with as it can be applied to multiple aspects of our experience from the human form through to the divine aspect.
We are each our own self, but in the authors perspective there is also a Self from which we all have been created from.
To simplify this; The Self and The Eternal Self/Source/God/etc - plus I feel the need to note the collective Selves or interconnectedness of all .
I felt the need to highlight there is more than our individual selves and the Divine. We are part of an interconnected collective.
One way to consider the Eternal Self's relationship to Our Selves, is that of our cells in our body to us.
“The Self” can be viewed through many different lens’ which can make understanding ourselves challenging at times.
The Self can be both simplistic and multifaceted.
We can refer to “_myself_” and “_oneself_”, or we can feel like “_a part of our self_” is experiencing something.

sections.content: Our sense of Self forms from the perception of our experience.
For example the roles we play, the way others see us, our past actions, right through to intangible qualities like the nature of our energy shape our sense of Self.
In the coming chapters you will be presented with the Self from different perspectives with a particular focus on:
- the ways in which we experience our Self
- the aspects that contribute to our sense of Self
- the stages of Self we go through.
To briefly touch on these points lets start with the ways we experience our Self…
### The Types of Selves Overview
This includes the Lower and Higher Selves, as well as the animal and divine nature that influence them.
### The Aspects of Self Overview
While the aspects which contribute to our sense of self range from tangible things such as our acute behaviours through to subtle aspects such as our values (and even the nature of our energy).
### The Stages of Self Overview

Whereas the stages we progress through in the journey of Self can be helpful to get an understanding of where one is at in their journey and finding practical insights to help navigate that particular stage.
